result_text:
I changed `exportZips()` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java` so `all_files.zip` no longer uses fixed file names. It now builds each entry name with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`. That is the same call the loose `aspect_*.txt` files are written with, so zip names and file names can't drift apart.

I ran `mvn -o -pl reports compile`, which succeeded. I did not run any tests or an actual export, so the renamed `buildAndDeployment` case is untested.

With the default config the entries and their order are unchanged. With the renamed aspect, `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt` goes in the fourth place. `git-history.zip` is written too, because the read that used to throw no longer fails.

`LandscapeAnalyzer.java` (lines 289–293) has the same fixed `aspect_*.txt` literals, including `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`. I left it alone since the task was about the export, so renaming an aspect may still affect that code.
